mentions.name: Veilleur
mentions.description: This tool turns any blog listing page into a RSS feed, so articles from JavaScript-rendered blogs without a feed can be loaded into the Cham archive.
mentions.problem: Blogs rendered with JavaScript often lack a RSS feed.
mentions.source_excerpt: and veilleur (https://github.com/jfim/veilleur) which turns any blog listing into a RSS feed. So this way I can take blogs that are rendered using JavaScript, don't have a RSS feed and load the articles directly into Cham.
